purpose: The grants the telecommunications and ICT development fund paid out in the year, on projects the minister selects.

notes: Baseline is actual, not appropriated: the fund sits outside the finance law and its own year-end accounts are the only stage printed. Because this row carries no appropriated figure and the year's other rows carry no actual, budget_source --share can no longer compute a domestic share for the year; that is accepted. Charges 91,582,905,996.44 = grants 91,339,434,899.41 + external services 241,068,032.03 + financial charges 2,403,065.00 (not held); income 63,631,922,372.65, of which operator contributions 62,930,510,446.48; net result -27,950,983,623.79.
